description: Wi-Fi free is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. Il dataset elenca tutti i punti di accesso alla rete Wi-Fi esistente sul territorio provinciale di Prato e gestiti sia dalla provincia di Prato che dal Comune di Prato. Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are comune-di-prato, geografico, infrastrutture, prato, regioni-e-citta. It offers 4 resource(s) in ARC, CSV, KML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
